Maria S.: Hey team - customer experiencing two issues: embeddings returning 403 (billing_exceeded) and separate generation calls intermittently 504 / high tail latency (~2-3s extra). They provided two request ids: rb-1a2b3c and rb-9f8e7d. Can we get minimal repro snippets (curl / py / js / go) + instructions to collect a debug bundle? Also confirm we should redact API keys before attaching logs.

Sam W.: Got it. Please paste the exact failing curl + the full response headers if you have them. Need model name, region, and SDK versions too. Redact tokens but keep x-request-id / redwood-request-id values.

Maria S.: Pasting the failing curl and response (redacted):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello world","model":"embed-lite-v1"}'
```
Response headers: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-request-id: rb-1a2b3c
content-type: application/json
```
Body: `{"error":"billing_exceeded","message":"account balance insufficient"}`

Also for generation: intermittent 504s:
```
POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate
x-request-id: rb-9f8e7d
status: 504
latency-ms: 3250
```

Tasha P.: I'll drop minimal SDK repros you can hand to the customer. Keep keys REDACTED in the examples.

Tasha P.: curl (minimal):
```
# embeddings - minimal repro
curl https://api.redwood.run/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"test","model":"embed-lite-v1"}'
```

Python (requests):
```
import requests
url = "https://api.redwood.run/v1/embeddings"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer REDACTED", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
json = {"input":"test","model":"embed-lite-v1"}
r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=json)
print(r.status_code, r.headers.get('x-request-id'))
print(r.text)
```

JS (node fetch):
```
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.run/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer REDACTED', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'test', model: 'embed-lite-v1' })
});
console.log(res.status, res.headers.get('x-request-id'))
console.log(await res.text())
```

Go (net/http):
```
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "io/ioutil"
)
func main() {
  payload := []byte(`{"input":"test","model":"embed-lite-v1"}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.run/v1/embeddings", bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer REDACTED")
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, _ := client.Do(req)
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(resp.StatusCode, resp.Header.Get("x-request-id"))
  fmt.Println(string(b))
}
```

Tasha P.: For generation 504 repro, swap endpoint and send a ~1k token prompt; include model and max_tokens to match customer usage.

Lee K.: Quick triage checklist:
- Collect both request ids' full server logs from infra (rb-1a2b3c, rb-9f8e7d)
- Capture SDK debug logs (set REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1 or use --verbose)
- Verify billing events around timestamps (billing API shows charge attempt?)
- Check routing: which region/cluster handled the request
- Reproduce locally with the minimal snippets above inside the customer's region (if possible)

support-bot: Generated debug bundle for thread: https://internal-debug.redwood/sessions/2009876543-attach
Note: bundle will include request traces, kernel selection, and batch logs. REDACT any API keys before you upload to the customer ticket.

Sam W.: When you attach logs to the ticket, include: request ids, SDK versions, region, model, and a short reproduction script (one of the above). If billing_exceeded is in the response we should escalate to billing-team with the invoice id + timestamp.

Maria S.: Thanks — I'm pulling the logs now. Will attach the debug bundle link and the minimal scripts to the support ticket after redaction. ETA 30m.

Sam W.: Perfect. If you hit inconsistent 504s after repro, ping #eng-runtime and include the debug bundle link so infra can correlate kernels and queues. :thumbsup:
